title: LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation
title_zh: 基于 LLM 智能体的 RISC-V CPU 设计与 FPGA 在环评估

paragraphs.en: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6 × \times faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cause analysis and a fix.
paragraphs.zh: CPU 候选设计的长时间 RTL 仿真可能耗时数小时，而短时间的诊断性运行可能遗漏在执行后期才显现的性能退化。 这种评估成本会延误基于 LLM 智能体的 CPU 开发中的设计决策。 我们提出一种开发环境，其中 LLM 智能体在 FPGA 上实现 CPU 候选设计，并利用板载性能测量来指导设计决策。 我们将其应用于在人工监督下把单周期 RV32I 核心开发为三发射乱序 RV32IM 核心的过程。 最终设计在 Artix-7 FPGA 上于 130 MHz 下达到 5.61 CoreMark/MHz。 对于运行 8,000 次 CoreMark 迭代的同一 CPU 候选设计，包括实现在内的 FPGA 评估比单线程 RTL 仿真快 9.6 × 倍。 在一个案例中，板载测量揭示了某个候选设计在长时间运行中出现的性能退化，而该设计在短时间诊断运行中表现有所提升。 该结果指导了候选设计的选择，并促成了基于 RTL 的根因分析和修复。

sents.en: We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core.
sents.zh: 我们将其应用于在人工监督下把单周期 RV32I 核心开发为三发射乱序 RV32IM 核心的过程。

sents.en: The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA.
sents.zh: 最终设计在 Artix-7 FPGA 上于 130 MHz 下达到 5.61 CoreMark/MHz。

sents.en: For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6 × \times faster than single-threaded RTL simulation.
sents.zh: 对于运行 8,000 次 CoreMark 迭代的同一 CPU 候选设计，包括实现在内的 FPGA 评估比单线程 RTL 仿真快 9.6 × 倍。

paragraphs.en: The performance and implementation cost of a CPU core depend on the choice of pipeline, issue width, branch prediction, and memory system. The open RISC-V instruction set architecture has made it practical to design cores that explore these choices. Kadomoto et al. designed RISC-V cores with different pipeline structures and compared their performance, power, and area [ 1 ] . Fu et al. evaluated single-issue, multi-issue, and out-of-order cores with a common SoC and implementation flow [ 2 ] . Beyond such comparisons, BOOM-Explorer searches BOOM microarchitecture parameters by multi-objective Bayesian optimization with active learning and a surrogate model [ 3 ] . ChatDSE explores a parameterized design space using LLM-based estimates of performance and power [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: CPU 核心的性能与实现成本取决于流水线、发射宽度、分支预测和存储系统的选择。 开放的 RISC-V 指令集架构使得设计探索这些选择的处理器核心成为可能。 Kadomoto 等人设计了具有不同流水线结构的 RISC-V 核心，并比较了它们的性能、功耗和面积 [ 1 ] 。 Fu 等人使用相同的 SoC 和实现流程评估了单发射、多发射和乱序核心 [ 2 ] 。 除此类比较之外，BOOM-Explorer 通过结合主动学习和代理模型的多目标贝叶斯优化来搜索 BOOM 的微架构参数 [ 3 ] 。 ChatDSE 利用基于大语言模型的性能和功耗估计来探索参数化的设计空间 [ 4 ] 。

sents.zh: CPU 核心的性能与实现成本取决于流水线、发射宽度、分支预测和存储系统的选择。

paragraphs.en: LLMs also generate and modify RTL. ChatCPU supports CPU design and verification from a specification and reported a RISC-V CPU tape-out [ 5 ] . El-Helwani and Khalid compared prompt structures for generating a single-cycle RV32I core and evaluated its FPGA implementation [ 6 ] . BluesFL maps instruction execution to code structure to support LLM-based fault localization in CPUs [ 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型也能生成和修改 RTL。 ChatCPU 支持从规范出发进行 CPU 设计与验证，并报道了一款 RISC-V CPU 的流片 [ 5 ] 。 El-Helwani 和 Khalid 比较了用于生成单周期 RV32I 核心的提示结构，并评估了其 FPGA 实现 [ 6 ] 。 BluesFL 将指令执行映射到代码结构，以支持基于大语言模型的 CPU 故障定位 [ 7 ] 。

sents.en: LLMs also generate and modify RTL.
sents.zh: 大语言模型也能生成和修改 RTL。

sents.en: ChatCPU supports CPU design and verification from a specification and reported a RISC-V CPU tape-out [ 5 ] .
sents.zh: ChatCPU 支持从规范出发进行 CPU 设计与验证，并报道了一款 RISC-V CPU 的流片 [ 5 ] 。

paragraphs.en: However, full-length RTL simulation can take hours to evaluate a CPU candidate. Short diagnostics reduce evaluation time but may miss performance degradation caused by predictor and scheduler state that develops during longer runs.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，完整长度的 RTL 仿真可能需要数小时才能评估一个 CPU 候选方案。 简短的诊断测试可以缩短评估时间，但可能会遗漏由预测器和调度器状态在较长运行过程中逐渐形成而导致的性能下降。

sents.en: However, full-length RTL simulation can take hours to evaluate a CPU candidate.
sents.zh: 然而，完整长度的 RTL 仿真可能需要数小时才能评估一个 CPU 候选方案。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has also integrated FPGA implementation into agent-based CPU development. In auto-arch-tournament, agents modify CPU RTL and perform functional checks, followed by FPGA place and route [ 8 ] . Its standard evaluation code runs CoreMark on Verilator and multiplies iterations per cycle by the Fmax from place and route. Programming and running a physical board are not part of this evaluation path.
paragraphs.zh: 已有工作还将 FPGA 实现整合进基于智能体的 CPU 开发中。 在 auto-arch-tournament 中，智能体修改 CPU RTL 并进行功能检查，随后执行 FPGA 布局布线 [ 8 ] 。 其标准评估代码在 Verilator 上运行 CoreMark，并将每周期的迭代次数乘以布局布线得到的 Fmax。 对物理开发板进行编程和运行并不属于该评估路径的一部分。

sents.en: Prior work has also integrated FPGA implementation into agent-based CPU development.
sents.zh: 已有工作还将 FPGA 实现整合进基于智能体的 CPU 开发中。

sents.zh: 其标准评估代码在 Verilator 上运行 CoreMark，并将每周期的迭代次数乘以布局布线得到的 Fmax。

sents.en: Programming and running a physical board are not part of this evaluation path.
sents.zh: 对物理开发板进行编程和运行并不属于该评估路径的一部分。

paragraphs.en: FPGA execution also supports cycle-exact system simulation in FireSim [ 9 ] and DNN accelerator design space exploration in Quickloop [ 10 ] . Lyra uses instruction streams from a generative model for differential testing and coverage collection on RISC-V FPGA cores [ 11 ] . Our focus is on feeding long-run board measurements back to LLM agents for CPU candidate selection and RTL analysis.
paragraphs.zh: FPGA 执行还支持 FireSim [ 9 ] 中的周期精确系统仿真，以及 Quickloop [ 10 ] 中的 DNN 加速器设计空间探索。 Lyra 使用来自生成式模型的指令流，在 RISC-V FPGA 核心上进行差分测试和覆盖率收集 [ 11 ] 。 我们的重点是将长时间运行的板级测量结果反馈给 LLM 智能体，用于 CPU 候选方案选择和 RTL 分析。

sents.en: FPGA execution also supports cycle-exact system simulation in FireSim [ 9 ] and DNN accelerator design space exploration in Quickloop [ 10 ] .
sents.zh: FPGA 执行还支持 FireSim [ 9 ] 中的周期精确系统仿真，以及 Quickloop [ 10 ] 中的 DNN 加速器设计空间探索。

sents.zh: Lyra 使用来自生成式模型的指令流，在 RISC-V FPGA 核心上进行差分测试和覆盖率收集 [ 11 ] 。

sents.zh: 我们的重点是将长时间运行的板级测量结果反馈给 LLM 智能体，用于 CPU 候选方案选择和 RTL 分析。

paragraphs.en: We make three contributions. First, we present a development environment that connects agent-driven RTL changes to on-board evaluation under human supervision. Second, we report the development of an RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core that exceeds published open-source 32-bit soft cores in CoreMark/MHz, with long-run board results guiding selection and analysis. Third, we compare the time to evaluate the same candidate by RTL simulation and on an FPGA.
paragraphs.zh: 我们做出了三项贡献。 首先，我们提出了一个开发环境，该环境在人类监督下将智能体驱动的 RTL 修改与板载评估相连接。 其次，我们报告了一个 RV32I 核心发展为三发射乱序 RV32IM 核心的过程，其在 CoreMark/MHz 上超过了已发表的开源 32 位软核，且长时间的板级结果指导了选择与分析。 第三，我们比较了通过 RTL 仿真和在 FPGA 上评估同一候选设计所需的时间。

sents.en: We make three contributions.
sents.zh: 我们做出了三项贡献。

sents.en: First, we present a development environment that connects agent-driven RTL changes to on-board evaluation under human supervision.
sents.zh: 首先，我们提出了一个开发环境，该环境在人类监督下将智能体驱动的 RTL 修改与板载评估相连接。

sents.en: Second, we report the development of an RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core that exceeds published open-source 32-bit soft cores in CoreMark/MHz, with long-run board results guiding selection and analysis.
sents.zh: 其次，我们报告了一个 RV32I 核心发展为三发射乱序 RV32IM 核心的过程，其在 CoreMark/MHz 上超过了已发表的开源 32 位软核，且长时间的板级结果指导了选择与分析。

sents.en: Third, we compare the time to evaluate the same candidate by RTL simulation and on an FPGA.
sents.zh: 第三，我们比较了通过 RTL 仿真和在 FPGA 上评估同一候选设计所需的时间。

paragraphs.en: Agents extend a single-cycle RV32I core using the verification and FPGA evaluation flow in Fig. 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体使用图 1 中的验证与 FPGA 评估流程扩展单周期 RV32I 内核。

paragraphs.en: The human set goals at each stage of CPU development and proposed directions such as multiple issue and out-of-order execution. The human also approved work and decided when to stop. Agents wrote and modified the CPU RTL and carried out detailed design, implementation, optimization, analysis, and verification. We used both single-agent and orchestrator–worker configurations during development. In the latter, GPT models [ 12 ] or Claude Opus 5.5 [ 13 ] coordinated design and review, while the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model [ 14 ] handled implementation and analysis. Tasks and reviews were exchanged through herdr v0.9.3 [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 人类在CPU开发的每个阶段设定目标，并提出了多发射、乱序执行等方向。 人类还负责审批工作成果并决定何时停止。 智能体编写并修改CPU的RTL，开展详细的设计、实现、优化、分析与验证工作。 在开发过程中，我们同时采用了单智能体和编排者—工作者两种配置。 在后者中，GPT模型[ 12 ]或Claude Opus 5.5 [ 13 ]负责协调设计与评审，而Qwen3.8-Flash-Next模型[ 14 ]负责实现与分析。 任务与评审通过herdr v0.9.3 [ 15 ]进行交换。

paragraphs.en: The orchestrator issues tasks that specify the change hypothesis, target files, verification conditions, acceptance criteria, and compute allocation. Each worker implements changes and evaluates candidates in a separate Git worktree, then reports the results.
paragraphs.zh: 编排器发出任务，任务中指明变更假设、目标文件、验证条件、验收标准和算力分配。 每个智能体在独立的 Git worktree 中实现变更并评估候选方案，然后报告结果。

sents.zh: 编排器发出任务，任务中指明变更假设、目标文件、验证条件、验收标准和算力分配。

sents.zh: 每个智能体在独立的 Git worktree 中实现变更并评估候选方案，然后报告结果。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 2 shows the evaluation setup. Agents in WSL2 call Vivado, hw_server, and the serial API on the Windows side. Resource usage and timing come from Vivado reports, and cycle counts and CRCs come from the board UART.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了评估设置。 智能体在 WSL2 中调用 Windows 侧的 Vivado、hw_server 和串口 API。 资源占用与时序结果来自 Vivado 报告，周期计数与 CRC 来自开发板 UART。

sents.en: Fig. 2 shows the evaluation setup.
sents.zh: 图 2 展示了评估设置。

sents.en: Agents in WSL2 call Vivado, hw_server, and the serial API on the Windows side.
sents.zh: 智能体在 WSL2 中调用 Windows 侧的 Vivado、hw_server 和串口 API。

sents.en: Resource usage and timing come from Vivado reports, and cycle counts and CRCs come from the board UART.
sents.zh: 资源占用与时序结果来自 Vivado 报告，周期计数与 CRC 来自开发板 UART。

paragraphs.en: Functional verification uses lint, directed tests for arithmetic, memory dependence, and branch recovery, and a per-retirement comparison with a reference model. In these tests, each retired instruction’s PC and register writeback are checked against a custom RV32IM instruction-set model implemented in Python. Board measurements informed performance-based candidate selection before full-length RTL simulation completed. Final acceptance still required matching UART output from a full-length simulation and two independent board runs using the frozen RTL and firmware.
paragraphs.zh: 功能验证使用 lint、针对算术、内存依赖和分支恢复的定向测试，以及与参考模型按每次退休指令进行的比对。 在这些测试中，每条退休指令的 PC 和寄存器写回都与一个用 Python 实现的自定义 RV32IM 指令集模型进行核对。 在完整长度的 RTL 仿真完成之前，板上测量数据为基于性能的候选方案选择提供了依据。 最终验收仍然要求使用冻结的 RTL 和固件，在完整长度仿真和两次独立的板上运行中获得一致的 UART 输出。

sents.zh: 最终验收仍然要求使用冻结的 RTL 和固件，在完整长度仿真和两次独立的板上运行中获得一致的 UART 输出。

paragraphs.zh: 所记录的是已采纳的三项变更的观测记录，并非完整普查。 FPGA 实现包括检查点恢复。

paragraphs.en: Each CPU design candidate has an identifier and a link to its parent design. We save the frozen RTL, firmware, implementation settings, logs, hashes, and the accept or reject decision. Tasks and reviews include the latest measurement results and failure reasons. Handover notes record measurements, running jobs, and next steps. Table I summarizes the recorded development activity for three changes incorporated into the final CPU: a load-wait predictor fix, register-move aliasing, and a two-way BTB.

paragraphs.en: We run CoreMark for 8,000 iterations, corresponding to a measured interval of 10.95 s and satisfying its 10 s minimum runtime [ 16 ] . We also evaluate 18 of the 19 Embench-IoT benchmarks, since cubic does not fit in the 32 KiB instruction memory. The final design targets a bare-metal RV32IM environment. It has a 32 KiB instruction memory and a 64 KiB data memory. The program and initial data are stored as FPGA memory initialization values.
paragraphs.zh: 我们运行 CoreMark 8,000 次迭代，对应实测时间间隔为 10.95 秒，满足其 10 秒的最短运行时间要求 [ 16 ]。 由于 cubic 无法放入 32 KiB 指令存储器，我们评估了 19 个 Embench-IoT 基准测试中的 18 个。 最终设计面向裸机 RV32IM 环境。 它具有 32 KiB 指令存储器和 64 KiB 数据存储器。 程序和初始数据以 FPGA 存储器初始化值的形式存储。

sents.en: We run CoreMark for 8,000 iterations, corresponding to a measured interval of 10.95 s and satisfying its 10 s minimum runtime [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 我们运行 CoreMark 8,000 次迭代，对应实测时间间隔为 10.95 秒，满足其 10 秒的最短运行时间要求 [ 16 ]。

sents.en: We also evaluate 18 of the 19 Embench-IoT benchmarks, since cubic does not fit in the 32 KiB instruction memory.
sents.zh: 由于 cubic 无法放入 32 KiB 指令存储器，我们评估了 19 个 Embench-IoT 基准测试中的 18 个。

sents.en: The final design targets a bare-metal RV32IM environment.
sents.zh: 最终设计面向裸机 RV32IM 环境。

sents.en: It has a 32 KiB instruction memory and a 64 KiB data memory.
sents.zh: 它具有 32 KiB 指令存储器和 64 KiB 数据存储器。

sents.en: The program and initial data are stored as FPGA memory initialization values.
sents.zh: 程序和初始数据以 FPGA 存储器初始化值的形式存储。

paragraphs.en: CoreMark performance is reported in iterations per second (iter/s). Elapsed time is the board-reported tick count divided by the MMCM frequency. IPC is the number of instructions retired during the measured interval divided by its tick count. We obtain both counts from a simulation of the same RTL and firmware.
paragraphs.zh: CoreMark 性能以每秒迭代次数（iter/s）报告。 经过时间为开发板报告的节拍计数除以 MMCM 频率。 IPC 是测量区间内退休的指令数除以该区间的节拍计数。 这两个计数均来自对同一 RTL 和固件的仿真。

sents.en: CoreMark performance is reported in iterations per second (iter/s).
sents.zh: CoreMark 性能以每秒迭代次数（iter/s）报告。

sents.en: Elapsed time is the board-reported tick count divided by the MMCM frequency.
sents.zh: 经过时间为开发板报告的节拍计数除以 MMCM 频率。

sents.en: IPC is the number of instructions retired during the measured interval divided by its tick count.
sents.zh: IPC 是测量区间内退休的指令数除以该区间的节拍计数。

sents.en: We obtain both counts from a simulation of the same RTL and firmware.

paragraphs.en: For the controlled CoreMark comparison, we use one frozen RTL and firmware configuration of the final design. The firmware was built with RISC-V GCC 13.2.0 at -O3 with additional unrolling ( -funroll-loops and related options) for 8,000 iterations. The RTL simulation model was built with Verilator 5.020 and run on a single thread with assertions disabled. All timings were measured on one host with an AMD Ryzen 7 5700X (8 cores, 16 threads) and 64 GB of memory, using Ubuntu 24.04 on WSL. Verilator and GCC ran on Ubuntu, and Vivado ran on Windows. We measured the wall-clock duration of each evaluation step. Model build, full-length simulation, FPGA re-implementation, and result capture were each measured once. Programming and result capture with an existing bitstream were measured three times. FPGA evaluation includes implementation, memory initialization updates, programming, and result capture. For Embench, one FPGA implementation is shared across all 18 benchmarks, with per-benchmark memory-initialization updates instead of repeated placement and routing. RTL evaluation includes model build and full-length execution. We timed successful evaluation runs after the shared firmware build. The FPGA re-implementation reused previously established settings and met setup and hold timing on the first attempt. Embench uses CPU_MHZ=130 .
paragraphs.zh: 在受控的 CoreMark 对比中，我们使用最终设计的一份冻结的 RTL 与固件配置。 固件使用 RISC-V GCC 13.2.0 以 -O3 优化并附加循环展开（-funroll-loops 及相关选项）构建，运行 8,000 次迭代。 RTL 仿真模型使用 Verilator 5.020 构建，并在关闭断言的情况下以单线程运行。 所有计时均在一台配备 AMD Ryzen 7 5700X（8 核 16 线程）和 64 GB 内存的主机上测量，系统为 WSL 上的 Ubuntu 24.04。 Verilator 和 GCC 运行在 Ubuntu 上，Vivado 运行在 Windows 上。 我们测量了每个评估步骤的实际耗时（墙钟时间）。 模型构建、全时长仿真、FPGA 重新实现以及结果采集各测量一次。 使用现有比特流进行编程和结果采集则测量三次。 FPGA 评估包括实现、存储器初始化更新、编程和结果采集。 对于 Embench，一次 FPGA 实现为全部 18 个基准测试共享，采用针对每个基准测试的存储器初始化更新，而非重复进行布局布线。 RTL 评估包括模型构建和全时长执行。 我们对共享固件构建之后成功完成的评估运行进行了计时。 FPGA 重新实现复用了先前确定的设置，并在首次尝试即满足建立与保持时序要求。 Embench 使用 CPU_MHZ=130。

sents.en: All timings were measured on one host with an AMD Ryzen 7 5700X (8 cores, 16 threads) and 64 GB of memory, using Ubuntu 24.04 on WSL.

sents.en: Verilator and GCC ran on Ubuntu, and Vivado ran on Windows.
sents.zh: Verilator 和 GCC 运行在 Ubuntu 上，Vivado 运行在 Windows 上。

sents.zh: 我们测量了每个评估步骤的实际耗时（墙钟时间）。

sents.en: Model build, full-length simulation, FPGA re-implementation, and result capture were each measured once.
sents.zh: 模型构建、全时长仿真、FPGA 重新实现以及结果采集各测量一次。

sents.zh: 使用现有比特流进行编程和结果采集则测量三次。

sents.zh: 我们对共享固件构建之后成功完成的评估运行进行了计时。

sents.zh: Embench 使用 CPU_MHZ=130。

paragraphs.en: Table II reports CoreMark/MHz for representative development stages and existing soft cores. Starting from the single-cycle RV32I core, we added a five-stage RV32IM pipeline, dual issue, and out-of-order execution with register renaming. We then restructured the design to increase its implementation frequency.
paragraphs.zh: 表 II 给出了代表性开发阶段和现有软核的 CoreMark/MHz 数据。 从单周期 RV32I 核开始，我们增加了五级 RV32IM 流水线、双发射以及基于寄存器重命名的乱序执行。 随后我们重构了设计，以提高其实现频率。

sents.en: Table II reports CoreMark/MHz for representative development stages and existing soft cores.
sents.zh: 表 II 给出了代表性开发阶段和现有软核的 CoreMark/MHz 数据。

sents.en: Starting from the single-cycle RV32I core, we added a five-stage RV32IM pipeline, dual issue, and out-of-order execution with register renaming.
sents.zh: 从单周期 RV32I 核开始，我们增加了五级 RV32IM 流水线、双发射以及基于寄存器重命名的乱序执行。

sents.en: We then restructured the design to increase its implementation frequency.
sents.zh: 随后我们重构了设计，以提高其实现频率。

paragraphs.en: Published soft-core results use speed grade -3 (this work uses -1) and different memory configurations, compiler settings, and design scopes.
paragraphs.zh: 已发表的软核结果使用速度等级 -3（本工作使用 -1）以及不同的存储器配置、编译器设置和设计范围。

paragraphs.en: The final design is a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core with register renaming (Fig. 3 ). It combines timing-aware pipeline partitioning with register-move aliasing and a two-way BTB. It reaches 730.6 iter/s at 130.137 MHz over 8,000 CoreMark iterations. Its 5.61 CoreMark/MHz is the highest in Table II , 12% above the published NaxRiscv result. The design uses 10,320 FFs, 32 BRAM tiles, and 4 DSPs, with setup/hold slack of +0.003/+0.035 ns and an IPC of 1.60. On Embench-IoT 1.0 [ 19 ] , it achieves a geometric-mean frequency-normalized score of 1.759 relative to the reference Cortex-M4 over 18 benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 最终设计是一款三发射宽度的乱序 RV32IM 核，带有寄存器重命名（图 3）。 它将时序感知的流水线划分与寄存器移动别名以及两路 BTB 相结合。 在 130.137 MHz 下运行 8,000 次 CoreMark 迭代，达到 730.6 iter/s。 其 5.61 CoreMark/MHz 是表 II 中最高的，比已发表的 NaxRiscv 结果高 12%。 该设计使用 10,320 个触发器、32 个 BRAM 块和 4 个 DSP，建立/保持时间裕量为 +0.003/+0.035 ns，IPC 为 1.60。 在 Embench-IoT 1.0 [19] 上，相对于参考的 Cortex-M4，它在 18 个基准测试中取得了几何平均频率归一化得分 1.759。

sents.en: The final design is a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core with register renaming (Fig. 3 ).
sents.zh: 最终设计是一款三发射宽度的乱序 RV32IM 核，带有寄存器重命名（图 3）。

sents.en: It combines timing-aware pipeline partitioning with register-move aliasing and a two-way BTB.
sents.zh: 它将时序感知的流水线划分与寄存器移动别名以及两路 BTB 相结合。

sents.en: It reaches 730.6 iter/s at 130.137 MHz over 8,000 CoreMark iterations.
sents.zh: 在 130.137 MHz 下运行 8,000 次 CoreMark 迭代，达到 730.6 iter/s。

sents.en: Its 5.61 CoreMark/MHz is the highest in Table II , 12% above the published NaxRiscv result.
sents.zh: 其 5.61 CoreMark/MHz 是表 II 中最高的，比已发表的 NaxRiscv 结果高 12%。

sents.en: The design uses 10,320 FFs, 32 BRAM tiles, and 4 DSPs, with setup/hold slack of +0.003/+0.035 ns and an IPC of 1.60.
sents.zh: 该设计使用 10,320 个触发器、32 个 BRAM 块和 4 个 DSP，建立/保持时间裕量为 +0.003/+0.035 ns，IPC 为 1.60。

sents.en: On Embench-IoT 1.0 [ 19 ] , it achieves a geometric-mean frequency-normalized score of 1.759 relative to the reference Cortex-M4 over 18 benchmarks.
sents.zh: 在 Embench-IoT 1.0 [19] 上，相对于参考的 Cortex-M4，它在 18 个基准测试中取得了几何平均频率归一化得分 1.759。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 compares RTL and FPGA evaluation times using identical RTL and firmware. For CoreMark, RTL evaluation took 3.91 h and FPGA evaluation took 24.5 min, a speedup of 9.6 × \times . For Embench, RTL evaluation took 15.05 h and FPGA evaluation took 65.7 min, a speedup of 13.7 × \times . With an existing bitstream, programming and result capture for CoreMark take a median of 27.5 s.
paragraphs.zh: 图4在使用相同RTL和固件的情况下比较了RTL与FPGA的评估时间。 对于CoreMark，RTL评估耗时3.91小时，FPGA评估耗时24.5分钟，加速比为9.6 × \times 。 对于Embench，RTL评估耗时15.05小时，FPGA评估耗时65.7分钟，加速比为13.7 × \times 。 使用现有比特流时，CoreMark的编程与结果采集的中位数时间为27.5秒。

sents.en: Fig. 4 compares RTL and FPGA evaluation times using identical RTL and firmware.
sents.zh: 图4在使用相同RTL和固件的情况下比较了RTL与FPGA的评估时间。

sents.en: For CoreMark, RTL evaluation took 3.91 h and FPGA evaluation took 24.5 min, a speedup of 9.6 × \times .
sents.zh: 对于CoreMark，RTL评估耗时3.91小时，FPGA评估耗时24.5分钟，加速比为9.6 × \times 。

sents.en: For Embench, RTL evaluation took 15.05 h and FPGA evaluation took 65.7 min, a speedup of 13.7 × \times .
sents.zh: 对于Embench，RTL评估耗时15.05小时，FPGA评估耗时65.7分钟，加速比为13.7 × \times 。

sents.en: With an existing bitstream, programming and result capture for CoreMark take a median of 27.5 s.
sents.zh: 使用现有比特流时，CoreMark的编程与结果采集的中位数时间为27.5秒。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated a predictor-modified core with TAGE-lite and a return address stack. It reduced cycles in a short 10-iteration diagnostic but increased the cycle count by 9.98% over 8,000 iterations. The baseline is the core before this extension, an intermediate design preceding the final core in Table II . The implementation agent used two independent board runs to reject the predictor-modified core and retain the baseline. Full-length RTL simulation reproduced the board tick count more than three hours later.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了一个采用 TAGE-lite 和返回地址栈的预测器改进型核心。 在一个仅 10 次迭代的短诊断中它减少了周期数，但在 8,000 次迭代中周期数增加了 9.98%。 基线是该扩展加入之前的核心，即表 II 中最终核心之前的一个中间设计。 实现智能体通过两次独立的板级运行否决了预测器改进型核心，并保留了基线。 完整长度的 RTL 仿真在三个多小时后复现了板级运行得到的节拍计数。

sents.en: We evaluated a predictor-modified core with TAGE-lite and a return address stack.
sents.zh: 我们评估了一个采用 TAGE-lite 和返回地址栈的预测器改进型核心。

sents.en: It reduced cycles in a short 10-iteration diagnostic but increased the cycle count by 9.98% over 8,000 iterations.
sents.zh: 在一个仅 10 次迭代的短诊断中它减少了周期数，但在 8,000 次迭代中周期数增加了 9.98%。

sents.en: The baseline is the core before this extension, an intermediate design preceding the final core in Table II .
sents.zh: 基线是该扩展加入之前的核心，即表 II 中最终核心之前的一个中间设计。

sents.en: The implementation agent used two independent board runs to reject the predictor-modified core and retain the baseline.
sents.zh: 实现智能体通过两次独立的板级运行否决了预测器改进型核心，并保留了基线。

sents.en: Full-length RTL simulation reproduced the board tick count more than three hours later.
sents.zh: 完整长度的 RTL 仿真在三个多小时后复现了板级运行得到的节拍计数。

paragraphs.en: The orchestrator then assigned the mismatch to a worker for per-iteration RTL analysis (Fig. 5 (a)). Fig. 6 shows the transition. The modified core used 2.62% fewer cycles over iterations 2–237, then entered a persistent slower state at iteration 238. Over iterations 239–2,000, it used 10.29% more cycles.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，编排器将该不匹配任务分配给一个智能体，用于逐次迭代的 RTL 分析（图 5 (a)）。 图 6 展示了该转变过程。 修改后的核心在第 2–237 次迭代中少用了 2.62% 的周期数，随后在第 238 次迭代进入了一种持续变慢的状态。 在第 239–2,000 次迭代中，它多用了 10.29% 的周期数。

sents.en: The orchestrator then assigned the mismatch to a worker for per-iteration RTL analysis (Fig. 5 (a)).
sents.zh: 随后，编排器将该不匹配任务分配给一个智能体，用于逐次迭代的 RTL 分析（图 5 (a)）。

sents.en: Fig. 6 shows the transition.
sents.zh: 图 6 展示了该转变过程。

sents.en: The modified core used 2.62% fewer cycles over iterations 2–237, then entered a persistent slower state at iteration 238.
sents.zh: 修改后的核心在第 2–237 次迭代中少用了 2.62% 的周期数，随后在第 238 次迭代进入了一种持续变慢的状态。

sents.en: Over iterations 239–2,000, it used 10.29% more cycles.
sents.zh: 在第 239–2,000 次迭代中，它多用了 10.29% 的周期数。

paragraphs.en: State tracing and ablation requested by the orchestrator identified an absorbing state in the load-wait predictor (Fig. 5 (b)). A load replay writes a distance-7 prediction that makes the load wait for older stores to commit. This prevents further replays and retraining while keeping a memory reservation station occupied. Clearing the predictor entry instead of storing distance 7 eliminated the abrupt slowdown in a 400-iteration RTL run of the modified core. The baseline running the modified-core firmware remains flat through 300 iterations, ruling out the firmware difference as the cause of the transition. The orchestrator requested a non-absorbing fix. After reviewing the worker’s comparison, it selected a fix with no additional state (Fig. 5 (c)).
paragraphs.zh: 由编排器请求的状态追踪与消融实验在加载等待预测器中发现了一个吸收态（图5 (b)）。 一次加载重放写入了一个距离为7的预测，使该加载等待较早的存储指令提交。 这在占用一个内存保留站的同时，阻止了进一步的重放和再训练。 在修改后核心的400次迭代RTL运行中，改为清除预测器表项而不是存储距离7，消除了这种突发的性能下降。 运行修改后核心固件的基线在300次迭代中保持平稳，排除了固件差异作为该转变原因的可能性。 编排器请求一个非吸收态的修复方案。 在审查工作体的比较结果后，它选择了一个不增加额外状态的修复方案（图5 (c)）。

sents.en: State tracing and ablation requested by the orchestrator identified an absorbing state in the load-wait predictor (Fig. 5 (b)).
sents.zh: 由编排器请求的状态追踪与消融实验在加载等待预测器中发现了一个吸收态（图5 (b)）。

sents.en: A load replay writes a distance-7 prediction that makes the load wait for older stores to commit.
sents.zh: 一次加载重放写入了一个距离为7的预测，使该加载等待较早的存储指令提交。

sents.en: This prevents further replays and retraining while keeping a memory reservation station occupied.
sents.zh: 这在占用一个内存保留站的同时，阻止了进一步的重放和再训练。

sents.en: Clearing the predictor entry instead of storing distance 7 eliminated the abrupt slowdown in a 400-iteration RTL run of the modified core.
sents.zh: 在修改后核心的400次迭代RTL运行中，改为清除预测器表项而不是存储距离7，消除了这种突发的性能下降。

sents.en: The baseline running the modified-core firmware remains flat through 300 iterations, ruling out the firmware difference as the cause of the transition.
sents.zh: 运行修改后核心固件的基线在300次迭代中保持平稳，排除了固件差异作为该转变原因的可能性。

sents.en: The orchestrator requested a non-absorbing fix.
sents.zh: 编排器请求一个非吸收态的修复方案。

sents.en: After reviewing the worker’s comparison, it selected a fix with no additional state (Fig. 5 (c)).
sents.zh: 在审查工作体的比较结果后，它选择了一个不增加额外状态的修复方案（图5 (c)）。

paragraphs.en: Vivado timing results also guided RTL changes. The register-move source substitution had a setup slack of − 0.291 -0.291 ns at 130.137 MHz. The orchestrator requested separating the substitution data from the instruction queue. The revised version uses a separate LUTRAM and a ready bit. The final design combines this revision with the two-way BTB and passed on-board acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: Vivado 时序结果也指导了 RTL 修改。 寄存器移动源替换方案在 130.137 MHz 下的建立时间裕量为 −0.291 ns。 调度器请求将替换数据从指令队列中分离出来。 修改后的版本使用独立的 LUTRAM 和一个就绪位。 最终设计将此修改与两路 BTB 相结合，并通过了板上验收测试。

paragraphs.en: We presented an FPGA-in-the-loop environment for human-supervised, agent-based CPU development. In the development case, on-board measurements guided candidate selection and subsequent RTL analysis and fixes. Including the cost of the initial FPGA implementation, FPGA evaluation was 9.6 × \times faster than RTL simulation for CoreMark and 13.7 × \times faster for the 18 Embench benchmarks. The resulting core reached 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on board, above published VexRiscv and NaxRiscv results. Selected development conversations from the long-run case study and representative CPU RTL snapshots are available online. 1 1 1 https://github.com/kadomoto-lab/llm-cpu-fpga-loop
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一个供人类监督的、基于智能体的CPU开发所用的FPGA在环环境。 在该开发案例中，板载测量结果引导了候选方案的选择以及后续的RTL分析与修复。 即使计入初始FPGA实现的成本，对于CoreMark而言，FPGA评估仍比RTL仿真快9.6 × \times倍，对于18个Embench基准测试则快13.7 × \times倍。 所得到的核心在板载130 MHz下达到了5.61 CoreMark/MHz，高于已发表的VexRiscv和NaxRiscv结果。 来自长期案例研究的精选开发对话以及具有代表性的CPU RTL快照可在网上获取。1 1 1 https://github.com/kadomoto-lab/llm-cpu-fpga-loop
